subtitle: (ROOTS)
description: Turn thousands of miles into moments of understanding. We help international students preserve the voices and untold chapters of their parents before time erases everything.
secondaryPopupContent:
I was born into a middle-class family in the heart of Hanoi, with everything I could ask for except one thing: **Connection**. Living with my family, I took that abundance for granted, even resenting it and longing to escape the label of 'family'.

Only when I lived alone in France, amidst the silent solitude of being abroad, did I have a shocking realization. Questions kept swirling in my mind: Why am I like this? Why am I so hard on them? And why... did I ever want to leave them so badly?

Being 10,000km away from home, I started to feel the **pressure of time** acutely. Every time I saw my parents through a phone screen, I realized I was living in a race I was sure to lose if I didn't act immediately. I feared the feeling of one day returning to find that all that was left were meaningless 'Have you eaten?' questions. I feared the 'too late' moment – when my parents' life lessons and youthful memories would vanish forever before I could understand them.

Especially my father – someone I've never been able to have a conversation with for more than 30 seconds in my entire life.

The wall I built around myself was so solid that I couldn't break it down with words alone. **ROOTS is the hammer I forged for myself**, to start breaking down those walls piece by piece.

I built ROOTS first and foremost for myself, and for anyone else who has a wall to break down like me. We won't be alone on this journey back home.
